facts.business: WSFx Global Pay Limited is a technology-led foreign exchange and cross-border payments company authorised by RBI as an AD Category-II, offering forex cards, outward remittances, currency exchange, and embedded payment solutions through digital and physical channels.
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with the related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of Companies Act, 2013 where applicable and the details have been disclosed in the notes to the financial statements, as required by the applicable accounting standards.
